description.p: Kinetic is a native 2D physics sandbox. Build scenes from rigid bodies, springs, ropes, joints, motors, pulleys and gears; add gravity zones, wind, electric and magnetic fields, liquids and optical elements; then run the simulation and measure it with graphs, force vectors, trails, energy readouts and trigger timers.

ul.li: SI units throughout, with a visible metres-to-pixels scale
Rewind, scrub and replay: every frame is reproduced exactly
Forces from formulas, parametric paths and ODEs solved with RK4
Ray optics with dispersion, total internal reflection and Fresnel reflection
Runs thousands of bodies at display frame rates
